page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn6v-c8g1.4xlarge is a GPU-accelerated compute instance designed for parallel computing and machine learning tasks. Hosted on the KVM hypervisor, this virtual machine is powered by an x86_64 Intel Xeon 8163 processor running at a base clock frequency of 2.5 GHz. It provides 16 dedicated virtual CPUs coupled with 64.0 GB of system memory, maintaining a balanced ratio of 4.0 GB of RAM per vCPU.

Hardware acceleration is supplied by two discrete NVIDIA V100 graphics processing units, contributing an aggregate of 32 GB of high-bandwidth VRAM (16 GB per GPU). The instance provides a baseline network bandwidth of 5 Gbps. No local storage is bundled with this instance type, requiring persistent cloud block storage volumes to be attached across the network interface for operating system files and dataset staging.

The combination of dedicated Intel Xeon cores and dual NVIDIA V100 accelerators offers targeted resource allocation for GPU-centric workloads without incurring the overhead of larger host partitions. The absence of onboard NVMe storage necessitates considerations for storage I/O limits over the network. Workloads best aligned with the ecs.gn6v-c8g1.4xlarge instance include deep learning model training, AI inference pipelines, scientific simulation, video transcoding, and distributed parallel computing.
